weapons.name: Service Carbine (M16A4)
weapons.bio: Standard-issue Leonida tactical rifle. High muzzle velocity and pinpoint accuracy for long-range street engagements against SWAT teams.

weapons.name: Heavy Rifle (FN SCAR-H)
weapons.bio: Hard-hitting modular battle rifle capable of shredding police cruiser engine blocks and penetrating body armor.

weapons.name: Tactical SMG (SIG MPX)
weapons.bio: Modern compact SMG ideal for drive-by suppression and tight indoor vault clearances.

weapons.name: Combat Shotgun (SPAS-12)
weapons.bio: Devastating close-quarters semi-auto shotgun. Clears narrow bank corridors and armored security checkpoints in seconds.

weapons.name: Heavy Sniper Mk II (.50 BMG)
weapons.bio: Long-range anti-materiel rifle used by Jason for overwatch sniping, disabling helicopter tail rotors, and breaching armored glass.

weapons.name: Portable Plasma Cutter
weapons.bio: Silent high-heat plasma torch that slices through reinforced vault hinges and display glass much faster than traditional thermal drills.

weapons.name: RFID Keycard Cloner
weapons.bio: Pocket-sized signal skimmer that clones bank manager keycards from 5 feet away without triggering silent alarms.

weapons.name: Tactical Zip-Tie Restraints
weapons.bio: Essential stealth heist item seen in the leaked diner robbery footage. Keeps hostages subdued silently so no one hits the panic button.

vehicles.name: Pfister Comet S2 Cabrio
vehicles.bio: Spotted along Ocean Drive in Trailer 1. Offers razor-sharp cornering through Vice Beach alleys and unmatched acceleration out of downtown bank zones.

vehicles.name: Pegassi Torero XO
vehicles.bio: High-roller Vice City supercar capable of outrunning VCPD air units along Interstate 97.

vehicles.name: Invetero Coquette D10
vehicles.bio: Mid-engine American exotic spotted outside Vice City nightclubs. Exceptional straight-line highway escape vehicle.

vehicles.name: Grotti Cheetah Classic
vehicles.bio: Iconic Vice City throw-back supercar. Appears prominently in Vice Beach patrols and cartel garages.

vehicles.name: Karin Sultan RS Classic
vehicles.bio: The ultimate 4-door heist getaway tuner. Transitions effortlessly from Vice City asphalt onto Grassrivers mud trails.

vehicles.name: Obey 10 F Widebody
vehicles.bio: Custom widebody exotic favored by high-tier fixers for rapid nighttime extraction across toll bridges.

vehicles.name: Vapid Sandking XL
vehicles.bio: Massive lifted truck confirmed in the Thrillbilly Mud Club scenes. Ploughs straight through VCPD roadblocks.

vehicles.name: Benefactor Dubsta 6x6
vehicles.bio: Six-wheel armored monster capable of carrying a full 4-man squad plus heavy gold bullion crates across swamp terrain.

vehicles.name: Mammoth Patriot Mil-Spec
vehicles.bio: Explosive-resistant tactical SUV built for direct assaults on armored convoys and federal depositories.

vehicles.name: VCPD Unmarked Cruiser
vehicles.bio: Stealth VCPD detective cruiser equipped with concealed LED strobes and police dispatch scanner.

vehicles.name: Leonida Highway Patrol Interceptor
vehicles.bio: High-speed state trooper interceptor patrolling Toll 1A and Interstate 97. Spotted with authentic tan-and-black Florida Highway Patrol styling.

vehicles.name: Nagasaki Buzzard
vehicles.bio: Compact tactical extraction chopper able to land directly on tight downtown Vice City rooftops.

properties.heistSynergy: Closest safehouse to Ocean Drive Armored Convoy ambush route.

properties.name: Neon Palms Nightclub & Lounge
properties.garage: 6-Car VIP Loading Bay + Armored Transit Van Slot
properties.laundering: Cash-Intensive Nightlife Enterprise (8% Fee • Passive +5% Weekly Bonus)
features: Underground money cleaning office with money counters
VIP lounge for recruiting syndicate specialist crew
properties.heistSynergy: Primary laundering pipeline for marked banknotes from Sinfrontera National Bank.

properties.name: Port Gellhorn Marine Logistics Warehouse
properties.district: Port Gellhorn Industrial Sector, Kelly County
properties.garage: 16-Car Fleet Garage + Drydock Crane & Boat Ramp
properties.laundering: Import/Export Maritime Customs Broker (12% Fee • Medium Speed)
features: Heavy vehicle maintenance lift for armored trucks
Storage for industrial mining drills & thermite lances
Direct canal slipway for instant water getaways
properties.heistSynergy: Mandatory staging headquarters for Port Gellhorn Container Terminal raid.

properties.name: Grassrivers Smuggler Hangar & Airfield Cabin
properties.laundering: Clandestine Air Cargo Broker (14% Fee • Zero Federal Oversight)
features: Private dirt airstrip supporting twin-engine cargo planes
properties.heistSynergy: Essential base of operations for Grassrivers Cartel Airstrip runs.

properties.name: Pelican Valley Farmhouse & Grain Silo Stash
features: Reinforced subterranean grain silo storm shelter
Disguised farm utility vehicles for covert transport
properties.heistSynergy: Closest safe drop point following the Pelican Valley Credit Union score.

properties.name: Ambrosia Neon Motel & Single-Bay Lockup
properties.laundering: Street Bullion Fence Network (22% Fee • Instant Cash)
features: Low-profile anonymity for early story progression
Quick getaway route to Interstate Toll 1A
properties.heistSynergy: Low-cost launch pad for duo convenience store and cash-in-transit jobs.
properties.source: Trailer 1 Motel Scene & Early Story Intel

declasse-tulip.name: Declasse Tulip M-100
declasse-tulip.heistRole: Primary Getaway Car // Jason & Lucia Starter Vehicle
declasse-tulip.bio: The signature personal getaway coupe for Jason and Lucia across Vice City and Kelly County. Powered by a carbureted big-block V8 with low-end torque perfect for power-sliding through narrow alleyways, ducking under highway overpasses, and shaking 3-star VCPD cruisers. Features a deep trunk capable of holding 4 cash bags and hidden stash compartments.

bravado-gauntlet-hellfire.name: Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire
bravado-gauntlet-hellfire.bio: Pure American brute force. 700+ supercharged horsepower engineered to break through police blockades and pull away from standard cruisers on long interstate stretches like the Vice City Turnpike. Fitted with heavy ramming bars, it turns head-on PIT maneuvers into devastating counter-attacks.

annis-elegy-retro.name: Annis Elegy Retro Custom
annis-elegy-retro.heistRole: Alleyway Escape & Undercover Street Meet Racer
annis-elegy-retro.bio: A legendary JDM tuner favored by Port Gellhorn street syndicates and tech specialists. Its intelligent all-wheel-drive system grips slick Florida rainstorms effortlessly, letting drivers execute sharp 90-degree handbrake turns through Little Haiti alleys where heavier pursuit cruisers spin out.

albany-buccaneer.name: Albany Buccaneer Custom
albany-buccaneer.heistRole: Low-Profile Covert Smuggling & Cartel Stash Car
albany-buccaneer.bio: A timeless Vice City classic lowrider with deep hydraulic suspension, velvet tuck upholstery, and enough trunk volume to hide half a million in laundered cartel bills. Blends in seamlessly among Little Cuba and Starlet Key, rarely drawing unwanted police suspicion.

vapid-dominator-asp.name: Vapid Dominator ASP
vapid-dominator-asp.bio: A high-revving track-focused muscle machine spotted in early bank heist rehearsals. Its stiffened chassis and aggressive aero package deliver high-speed stability through the bridges connecting Vice City mainland to the beaches.

declasse-vigero-zx.name: Declasse Vigero ZX Convertible
declasse-vigero-zx.bio: Modern American performance with an open roof option that allows rear crew members to fire 360-degree suppressive automatic fire at pursuing helicopters and patrol vehicles. Features launch control for lightning-fast getaways.

dinka-blista-compact.name: Dinka Blista Compact
dinka-blista-compact.bio: Small, featherweight, and practically invisible to police traffic dispatch. Can squeeze through pedestrian bollards, parking garage service walkways, and canal footbridges where heavy squad cars get stuck.

bravado-rat-loader.name: Bravado Rat-Loader 500
bravado-rat-loader.bio: A rust-patinated Kelly County rat rod built on a solid iron ladder frame. Unstoppable when cutting across sugar cane fields and swamp trails to dump heat before hitting the state line.

vapid-slamvan-custom.name: Vapid Slamvan Custom
vapid-slamvan-custom.heistRole: Cargo Loot Hauler // Heavy Cash Stash
vapid-slamvan-custom.bio: Custom built by Brian Heder’s chop shop network. Boasts a dropped stance, massive rear tires, and a lockable diamond-plate tonneau cover that secures bulky loot stashes.

declasse-sabre-turbo.name: Declasse Sabre Turbo Classic
declasse-sabre-turbo.bio: A high-displacement muscle powerhouse from the golden era of Vice City street racing. Straight-line acceleration can outpace helicopter searchlights across open causeways.

albany-hermes.name: Albany Hermes Lead Sled
albany-hermes.heistRole: Syndicate Boss Escort & Mob Safehouse Courier
albany-hermes.bio: Chopped roof, flame job, and airtight bullet-resistant privacy glass. The preferred transport for veteran mob bookmakers moving dirty cash bags without attracting federal eyes.

schyster-deviant.name: Schyster Deviant Restomod
schyster-deviant.bio: A restomod marvel combining vintage muscle lines with 2026 supercar suspension and massive 6-piston Brembo brakes that stop on a dime during tight downtown Vice City evasions.

imponte-phoenix.name: Imponte Phoenix Trans-Am
imponte-phoenix.bio: Famous screaming bird hood decal with straight-pipe thunder. Ideal as a designated decoy car to trigger highway pursuit units away from the primary loot truck.

bravado-banshee.name: Bravado Banshee 900R
bravado-banshee.bio: The immortal king of GTA getaways. 10 cylinders of naturally aspirated terror that hits nearly 180 MPH on the MacArthur Causeway before pursuing police interceptors can shift into top gear.

grotti-cheetah.name: Grotti Cheetah Classic
grotti-cheetah.bio: The definitive Miami Vice symbol. Side strakes, pop-up headlights, and a flat-12 exhaust scream that echoes off the neon hotel facades of Ocean Beach. Perfect for high-stakes casino infiltrations.

pfister-comet-s2.name: Pfister Comet S2 Cabrio
pfister-comet-s2.bio: Launches from 0 to 60 in 2.6 seconds flat, even on wet asphalt during tropical thunderstorms. If a bank job turns hot in torrential rain, this is the #1 exfiltration vehicle in Leonida.

invetero-coquette-d10.name: Invetero Coquette D10
invetero-coquette-d10.heistRole: VIP Fast Extraction // Highway Pursuit Disruption
invetero-coquette-d10.bio: American mid-engine exotic capable of supercar speeds at a fraction of the maintenance footprint. Dual luggage compartments allow splitting cash packs between front and rear bays.

grotti-furia.name: Grotti Furia Hypercar
grotti-furia.heistRole: Ultra-High Value Diamond & Bearer Bond Courier
grotti-furia.bio: The peak of European hypercar luxury in Vice City. With active aerodynamic spoilers and hybrid electric boost, it vanishes into thin air before dispatch can coordinate spike strips.

dewbauchee-champion.name: Dewbauchee Champion Spec
dewbauchee-champion.source: Vice City Marina Leaked Parking Deck
dewbauchee-champion.bio: Equipped with cutting-edge radar jamming technology that disrupts police helicopter search tracking and automated speed cameras throughout downtown Vice City.

pegassi-torero-xo.name: Pegassi Torero XO
pegassi-torero-xo.bio: Scissor doors, angular retro-futuristic bodywork, and a blistering top speed that leaves state trooper Ford Explorers choking on rubber fumes.

grotti-carbonizzare.name: Grotti Carbonizzare Spyder
grotti-carbonizzare.bio: Retractable hardtop convertible that allows blending in with high-society patrons outside vice bank vaults before switching tags and executing a rapid escape.

benefactor-schafter-v12.name: Benefactor Schafter V12 Armored
benefactor-schafter-v12.bio: The undisputed king of 4-door armored extraction sedans. Protects all 4 crew members from sniper rifle fire while hitting 165 MPH down the interstate.

pfister-astron-custom.name: Pfister Astron Custom
pfister-astron-custom.bio: Combines the interior cargo space of an SUV with the cornering reflexes of a 911. Can jump concrete highway medians without tearing out its oil pan.

progen-itali-gtb.name: Progen Itali GTB Custom
progen-itali-gtb.bio: Track-tuned aerodynamic downforce and instantaneous throttle response make this British supercar practically untouchable in sweeping high-speed bends.

ocelot-jugular.name: Ocelot Jugular Super Sedan
ocelot-jugular.bio: A 600-horsepower all-wheel-drive super sedan with a guttural supercharger whine. Seats 4 heavily armed crew operatives with gear while keeping pace with mid-engine exotics.

vcpd-cruiser.name: VCPD Police Interceptor Cruiser
vcpd-cruiser.realName: Ford Police Interceptor Sedan (Taurus) & Crown Vic
vcpd-cruiser.heistRole: Infiltration Disguise // Police Radio Scanner Hub
vcpd-cruiser.bio: The front-line squad car of the Vice City Police Department. Equipped with automated license-plate recognition cameras, emergency strobe arrays, and heavy-duty steel push bumpers designed for PIT maneuvers at 90+ MPH. Stealing one grants real-time access to police tactical radio frequencies.

buffalo-stx.name: Bravado Buffalo STX Pursuit Package
buffalo-stx.realName: Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat Police Package
buffalo-stx.bio: Assigned to the Leonida Highway Patrol Special Response Unit. Features reinforced steel wheels, push-bar bumper extensions, and a high-output supercharged engine capable of overtaking modified street racers on open causeways.

vcpd-riot.name: Brute Tactical Riot Enforcer
vcpd-riot.heistRole: Unstoppable Extraction Fortress // Bank Door Breacher
vcpd-riot.bio: A 17,000-pound armored juggernaut impervious to small-arms fire and spike strips. Its hydraulic front ram plate can smash through security gates, bank security roll-up doors, and police roadblock vehicles.

vcpd-park-ranger.name: Declasse Granger 3600LX Park Ranger
vcpd-park-ranger.bio: Patrols the vast Grassrivers wetland park perimeter. Equipped with roof lightbars, off-road winches, and lifted heavy suspension that charges through 3 feet of swamp water without stalling.

vcpd-unmarked.name: VCPD Unmarked Tactical Cruiser
vcpd-unmarked.bio: Blends into civilian traffic with zero external roof lights or livery. Hidden blue-and-red strobes behind the grille allow sudden tactical ambushes and high-speed pursuit interception.

predator-patrol.name: Coast Guard Predator Interceptor
predator-patrol.source: Vice City Harbor Leaks & Trailer 1 Marina
predator-patrol.bio: The maritime enforcement arm of Leonida State. Armed with dual high-output outboards that track down cigarette smuggling boats through Biscayne Bay and outer barrier reefs.

vcpd-maverick.name: VCPD Police Maverick Chopper
vcpd-maverick.source: Trailer 1 Vice City Skyline Night Searchlight
vcpd-maverick.bio: Equipped with a high-intensity NightSun searchlight and FLIR thermal camera that tracks suspects through building shadow lines. Stealing one provides an unmatched rooftop heist escape route.

karin-rebel.name: Karin Rebel 4x4 Off-Road
karin-rebel.bio: Virtually unkillable Japanese truck famous for surviving extreme abuse. Fitted with 35-inch swamp tires and snorkel intake to cross deep bayous where city squad cars flood their engines.

vapid-sandking-xl.name: Vapid Sandking XL Crew Cab
vapid-sandking-xl.realName: Ford F-350 Super Duty Dually Lifted
vapid-sandking-xl.source: Trailer 1 Mud Club & Dirt Track Scene
vapid-sandking-xl.bio: Monstrous ground clearance that literally drives over normal civilian sedans during traffic gridlocks. The heavy-duty suspension absorbs 4-foot curb drops without flinching.

canis-seminole-frontier.name: Canis Seminole Frontier 4x4
canis-seminole-frontier.heistRole: Low-Key Country Getaway & Smuggler Trail Runner
canis-seminole-frontier.bio: A favorite of Leonida locals and back-alley runners. Low key, easy to hotwire, and equipped with a full-time 4WD transfer case that cuts across marsh ditches unnoticed.

benefactor-dubsta-6x6.name: Benefactor Dubsta 6x6 Heavy
benefactor-dubsta-6x6.bio: With six driven wheels on portal axles, this bespoke military-derived juggernaut climbs over shoreline seawalls and mud dunes that leave standard pursuit SUVs high-centered.

bravado-dorado.name: Bravado Dorado Custom
bravado-dorado.bio: The definition of urban camouflage. Looks like an ordinary grocery-getter from 50 yards away, but packs a torquey Magnum V8 that hauls a full 4-man crew away from downtown jewelry stores.

albany-cavalcade-xl.name: Albany Cavalcade XL Luxury
albany-cavalcade-xl.heistRole: Cartel Boss Escort & Heavy Syndicate Command
albany-cavalcade-xl.bio: 682 supercharged horses wrapped in obsidian black leather and chrome. Provides bullet-resistant privacy for crew commanders coordinating escape routes via the syndicate second screen.

mammoth-patriot-milspec.name: Mammoth Patriot Mil-Spec
mammoth-patriot-milspec.bio: Wider than a city bus lane, this military workhorse plows through spike strips using an onboard central tire inflation system that keeps moving even with punctured rubber.

declasse-rancher-xl.name: Declasse Rancher XL 4x4
declasse-rancher-xl.bio: A vintage steel-bodied utility workhorse with endless interior cabin room to stack millions in stolen bank bills under fishing gear and camping equipment.

nagasaki-street-blazer.name: Nagasaki Street Blazer ATV
nagasaki-street-blazer.heistRole: Swamp Trail Quick Scout & Beach Infiltration
nagasaki-street-blazer.source: Trailer 1 Vice Beach Sand Cruising Scene
nagasaki-street-blazer.bio: Lightweight two-stroke quad bike that cuts across soft beach sands, coastal dunes, and narrow swamp embankments where heavy four-wheeled pursuit cruisers immediately sink.

seasparrow.name: Sea Sparrow Amphibious Chopper
seasparrow.bio: Fitted with twin marine pontoons, the Sea Sparrow lands on ocean swells, inland canals, and swamp bayous alike. The ultimate water-to-air escape vehicle for offshore luxury yacht robberies.

grotti-squalo.name: Grotti Squalo Cigarette Boat
grotti-squalo.heistRole: Maritime Contraband Dash to International Waters
grotti-squalo.bio: The quintessential Vice City cigarette speed racer. Cracks 85 knots over choppy coastal swells, easily outrunning standard police harbor patrol craft as you head into international waters.

shitzu-tropic.name: Shitzu Tropic Cabin Cruiser
shitzu-tropic.bio: Equipped with lower sleeping berths, kitchen galley, and a private stash hold to count cash while anchored off the Key West archipelago.

nagasaki-dinghy.name: Nagasaki Dinghy Tactical RIB
nagasaki-dinghy.heistRole: Stealth Shoreline Landing & Storm Drain Insertion
nagasaki-dinghy.bio: Rigid inflatable hull favored by navy SEAL teams and syndicate divers. Can navigate extremely shallow storm runoff canals right beneath downtown Vice City bank vaults.

dinka-marquis.name: Dinka Marquis Luxury Sailboat
dinka-marquis.bio: Produces zero engine noise and a tiny radar signature under sail. Ideal for smuggling millions worth of diamonds and bearer bonds past Coast Guard thermal listening buoys.

western-duster.name: Western Duster Crop Duster Plane
western-duster.bio: Can take off and land on unpaved dirt dikes and sugar cane roads in under 400 feet. The empty chemical hopper holds enough bulk cash to clear out an entire county bank vault.

buckingham-maverick.name: Buckingham Maverick VIP Chopper
buckingham-maverick.bio: Quiet, plush, and engineered with an enclosed Fenestron tail rotor for tight rooftop landings on luxury skyscraper pads across downtown Vice City.

jobuilt-velum.name: JoBuilt Velum 5-Seater Plane
jobuilt-velum.bio: Cruises at 31,000 feet far above state police helicopters. The ultimate high-altitude getaway craft to transport your crew and the total take out of Leonida jurisdiction.

vapid-speedo.name: Vapid Speedo Express Lockup
vapid-speedo.heistRole: Bulky Heavy Loot Transport & Utility Disguise
vapid-speedo.bio: Disguised with fictional local laundry or HVAC commercial logos. Blends in 100% anywhere in urban Vice City while carrying the entire haul from a major jewelry exchange.

brute-boxville.name: Brute Boxville Armored Courier
brute-boxville.realName: Step Van P-Series Armored Postal Truck
brute-boxville.heistRole: Gold Bullion & Heavy Bank Vault Loot Hauler
brute-boxville.bio: Heavy roll-up rear cargo doors with reinforced deadbolts. Built specifically to transport pallets of gold bullion and heavy safe deposit lockboxes.

maibatsu-mule.name: Maibatsu Mule Logistics Transporter
maibatsu-mule.heistRole: Massive Hardware Moving & Chop Shop Supply
maibatsu-mule.bio: The backbone of Port Gellhorn cargo transit. Able to transport heavy equipment, cutting torches, hydraulic jacks, and tons of raw loot across county lines.

western-sovereign.name: Western Sovereign Touring Bagger
western-sovereign.bio: Equipped with lockable hard fiberglass saddlebags and a full touring fairing that splits congested highway lanes at over 100 MPH.

pegassi-bati-801.name: Pegassi Bati 801 Superbike
pegassi-bati-801.bio: With a 2.5-second sprint to 60 MPH and razor-sharp steering geometry, the Bati 801 weaves between gridlocked freeway lanes where no patrol car can follow.

nagasaki-bf400.name: Nagasaki BF400 Enduro Rally Bike
nagasaki-bf400.bio: Long-travel rally suspension lets this enduro bike hop over pedestrian curbs, launch down concrete drainage stairs, and tear across muddy marshland trails with ease.

principe-nemesis.name: Principe Nemesis Streetfighter
principe-nemesis.bio: Wide motocross handlebars and upright riding ergonomics give riders incredible low-speed leverage to flick around tight street corners and evade VCPD cruiser roadblocks.

polymer.name: Polymer Pistol 9mm
polymer.attachments: Osprey Suppressor, Red Dot Micro Sight, 33-Round Drum, Streamlight TLR-7 Light/Laser
polymer.bio: The gold-standard compact striker-fired polymer sidearm carried by Lucia in the opening trailer diner robbery. Lightweight, failure-proof even when dropped in muddy Leonida wetlands, and offers near-total concealment under casual clothing.

beretta.name: Service Pistol 92FS
beretta.attachments: Threaded Barrel, Tactical Suppressor, Inox Match Trigger, Wooden Grip Panels
beretta.source: Jason Duval Official Character Stash Art & VCPD Armory
beretta.bio: Classic Italian open-slide double-action military sidearm with smooth recoil characteristics and flawless feeding reliability. Standard issue for many veteran law enforcement officers and Jason’s preferred defensive weapon.

mustang357.name: Mustang .357 Heavy Magnum
mustang357.attachments: Ventilated Rib Barrel, Pachmayr Rubber Grips, 2x Handgun Scope, Speedloader Rings
mustang357.bio: High-polish stainless steel revolver packing devastating stopping power. Can punch through car doors and engine blocks at close range. One shot to center-mass drops unarmored guards instantly.

browning-hipower.name: Vintage P35 High-Power
browning-hipower.attachments: Classic Walnut Grips, Ring Hammer, Novak Night Sights
browning-hipower.bio: Historic single-action sidearm favored by veteran Caribbean contraband runners and cartel lieutenants for its crisp trigger break and ergonomic grip angle.

taurus-judge.name: The Enforcer .410 Revolver
taurus-judge.attachments: Fiber Optic Front Sight, Ribber Grip
taurus-judge.bio: Chambered in .410 shotgun buckshot shells. Devastating in close-quarters bank vestibule hold-ups where spreading shot clears out multiple security guards at once.

mp5.name: Tactical MP5 Submachine Gun
mp5.attachments: Integral SD Suppressor, Collapsible Stock, Tri-Rail Forend, Holo Sight
mp5.bio: The undisputed gold standard in roller-delayed submachine guns. Almost non-existent recoil allows putting an entire 30-round magazine into a 4-inch cluster while moving down bank hallways.

micro-smg.name: Micro Machine Pistol 9mm
micro-smg.attachments: Folding Wire Stock, Extended 32-Rd Stick Mag, Compensator
micro-smg.bio: Blistering 1,200 rounds per minute cyclic rate that empties a full magazine in under two seconds. The ultimate drive-by weapon from the driver seat of a getaway car.

tec9.name: AB-10 Machine Pistol
tec9.attachments: Ventilated Barrel Shroud, 50-Rd Drum, Threaded Barrel Extender
tec9.source: Vice City Little Haiti Gang Leaks
tec9.bio: Infamous 90s Vice City street syndicate staple. Intimidating barrel shroud profile and massive 50-round drum magazine make it deadly for vault corridor suppressive fire.

p90.name: Tactical Bullpup PDW-57
p90.attachments: Integrated Reflex Optic, Side Tactical Lasers, Gemtech Suppressor
p90.bio: Compact bullpup design chambered in high-velocity 5.7mm armor-piercing rounds that slice through Kevlar vests worn by armored car transit guards.

carbine.name: Duke Special Ops Carbine M4
carbine.attachments: ACOG 4x Scope, PEQ-15 Infrared Laser, Angled Foregrip, SOCOM Suppressor
carbine.source: Trailer 1 SWAT & Raul Bautista Syndicate Arsenal
carbine.bio: The military standard issue assault rifle. Extreme modularity and accuracy at medium-to-long ranges, capable of penetrating engine blocks and heavy ballistic glass.

ak47.name: Kalashnikov AK-103 Assault Rifle
ak47.attachments: Heavy Muzzle Brake, Kobra Red Dot, 75-Round Drum, Side-Folding Polymer Stock
ak47.bio: Heavy 7.62mm stopping power that punches straight through concrete parking garage pillars and armored police vehicles. Incurably reliable in Leonida sand and mud.

compact-rifle.name: Micro Draco Compact Rifle
compact-rifle.attachments: KNS Piston, Flash Hider, SB Tactical Arm Brace
compact-rifle.bio: A chopped-down AK platform with a 6-inch barrel that produces deafening concussive blasts and blinding muzzle fire. Offers rifle power in a package that fits under a windbreaker.

battle-rifle.name: Heavy Battle Rifle 7.62 NATO
battle-rifle.attachments: Elcan SpecterDR Optic, Harris Bipod, Heavy Flash Suppressor
battle-rifle.bio: The Right Hand of the Free World. Hits with sledgehammer energy at extreme distances, disabling pursuing patrol vehicles with shots through the radiator grille.

pump-shotgun.name: Tactical 12-Gauge Pump Shotgun
pump-shotgun.attachments: Door Breaching Choke, Heat Shield, Side-Saddle 6-Shell Carrier, Magpul Forend with Tac-Light
pump-shotgun.bio: The ultimate room clearer and vault breach tool. Loaded with 00 buckshot, it tears open wooden security doors and immobilizes advancing swat teams in tight hallways.

sawed-off.name: Sawed-Off Double Barrel
sawed-off.bio: Both barrels sawed down to 8 inches. Empties a devastating wall of lead at point-blank range, turning armored vault locks and cash registers into shattered fragments.

combat-shotgun.name: SPAS-12 Combat Auto-Shotgun
combat-shotgun.attachments: Folding Metal Stock with Hook, Choke Adapter, EOTech Red Dot
combat-shotgun.source: Vice City Ocean Beach Gun Shop Leak
combat-shotgun.bio: Iconic folding-stock combat shotgun that cycles semi-automatic 12-gauge magnum shells as fast as the operator pulls the trigger.

grenade-launcher.name: Compact 40mm Thumper Launcher
grenade-launcher.attachments: Leaf Sight, Padded Recoil Pad, Quad-Rail Mount
grenade-launcher.bio: Lobs 40mm high-explosive or CS tear gas rounds with pinpoint trajectory over police barricades, flipping swat vans and clearing entire intersections in one thud.

rpg7.name: Heavy Anti-Tank RPG-7
rpg7.attachments: PGO-7V Optical Sight, Heat Warhead, Tandem Charge
rpg7.bio: Devastating anti-armor launcher capable of blowing VCPD riot enforcers and police helicopters out of the sky in a blinding flash of shaped-charge explosive force.

sniper.name: Duke Assault Sniper Rifle
sniper.attachments: Nightforce 25x Mil-Dot Scope, Harvester 338 Suppressor, Folding Skeleton Stock, Carbon Bipod
sniper.bio: Extreme-range bolt-action precision platform used for high-angle overwatch missions. One well-placed shot through the engine block disables pursuit vehicles before they reach the safehouse.

heavy-sniper.name: Anti-Material .50 Cal Sniper
heavy-sniper.attachments: Thermal Sniper Scope, Arrowhead Muzzle Brake, Bipod
heavy-sniper.source: Vice Port Military Guard Tower Scene
heavy-sniper.bio: Fires massive 660-grain armor-piercing incendiary rounds that detonate fuel tanks and tear through reinforced bunker walls from over a mile away.

hammer.name: Forged Steel Claw Hammer
hammer.bio: Made famous in the first GTA 6 trailer by the neighborhood watch woman. Perfect for shattering jewelry display cases, disabling security cameras silently, and cracking door locks.

baseball-bat.name: Solid Hardwood Baseball Bat
baseball-bat.attachments: Tar Grip Wrap, Barbed Wire Wrap Option
baseball-bat.source: Port Gellhorn Street Brawl & Pawn Shop Leaks
baseball-bat.bio: The classic intimidation weapon. A couple of swings against a bank teller’s bulletproof glass instantly skyrockets the intimidation meter without firing a shot and alerting police dispatch.

crowbar.name: Hardened Steel Wrecking Crowbar
crowbar.bio: Dual-purpose heist tool. Used to quietly pry open security fire doors, electrical junction boxes, and ATM access panels, or wielded as a crushing close-quarters weapon.

combat-knife.name: Tactical Tanto Combat Knife
combat-knife.attachments: Kydex Sheath, Serrated Spine, Non-Reflective Epoxy Coating
combat-knife.bio: Black epoxy-coated 7-inch tanto blade designed for silent takedowns of security sentries from behind. Leaves zero shell casings or acoustic signature.

mask-skull.name: Neoprene Skull Balaclava
mask-skull.perk: Blocks CCTV facial recognition & delays 911 caller identification by 35 seconds.
mask-skull.bio: Jason’s signature heist face covering. Made of breathable weather-resistant neoprene that conceals facial geometry from automated bank security cameras and state surveillance databases.

mask-pink-bandana.name: Vice City Flamingo Pink Bandana
mask-pink-bandana.perk: Fastest equip animation during sudden cash register grab-and-dashes.
mask-pink-bandana.source: Official Lucia Key Art & Diner Holdup
mask-pink-bandana.bio: Lucia’s iconic pink paisley bandana worn in quick-strike convenience store and pawn shop robberies. Can be pulled up or dropped in under 0.5 seconds.

mask-ballistic.name: Level III-A Ballistic Face Shield
mask-ballistic.perk: Negates 1 fatal headshot from law enforcement pistol fire.
mask-ballistic.bio: Molded ceramic-aramid composite face plate that deflects handgun shrapnel and direct 9mm headshots. Terrifies hostages and bank staff during heavy assaults.

mask-stocking.name: Retro Nylon Stocking Mask
mask-stocking.perk: Zero suspicion when stored in pockets; discarded instantly into trash bins.
mask-stocking.bio: The classic low-budget Bonnie & Clyde distortion mask. Crushes facial features against nylon mesh, confounding eyewitness descriptions given to arriving police officers.

mask-clown.name: Port Gellhorn Smiley Clown Mask
mask-clown.perk: +20% Hostage Intimidation Speed; suppresses crowd panic alarms.
mask-clown.source: Port Gellhorn Amusement Pier Robbery Scene
mask-clown.bio: Disturbing molded fiberglass clown mask with manic painted smile. Greatly increases intimidation effect against crowds, keeping bystanders flat on the floor.

mask-animal.name: Vice Beach Neon Pig Rubber Mask
mask-animal.perk: Cult following bonus; unlocks unique syndicate underground dialogue.
mask-animal.source: Ocean Drive Street Party Leaked Encounter
mask-animal.bio: Grotesque neon-splattered latex pig mask worn by reckless street crews. Confuses CCTV facial indexing by replacing human contours with animal features.

outfit-scuba.name: Rebreather Scuba Diving Rig
outfit-scuba.perk: Unlimited underwater breathing; zero air bubbles on radar sonar.
outfit-scuba.bio: Military closed-circuit rebreather rig that produces zero surface bubbles. Allows diving into downtown stormwater canals to breach bank basements undetected.

outfit-hazmat.name: Biohazard Level A Hazmat Suit
outfit-hazmat.perk: Complete immunity to tear gas, smoke canisters, and chemical dispersants.
outfit-hazmat.bio: Bright yellow pressurized hazmat suit with self-contained air tanks. Lets operatives walk straight through heavy tear gas clouds without taking damage or coughing.

outfit-vcpd.name: VCPD Metro Police Uniform Disguise
outfit-vcpd.perk: Walk through police barricades and restricted evidence lockups without drawing heat.
outfit-vcpd.bio: Authentic Vice City Police Department patrol uniform complete with forged gold badge, duty belt, and radio clip. Allows walking right past perimeter checkpoints.

outfit-utility.name: Port Gellhorn Stevedore Coveralls
outfit-utility.perk: Full access to cargo container shipping terminals and industrial docks.
